record_scope_reconstruction: Three Turkish Cypriot-side suspensions present at the beginning of 2021: Lefka–Apliki, Deryneia and Kato Pyrgos–Karavostasi/Limnitis. Green Line crossing routes, not interstate frontiers. These are not automatically continuous with the separate 2020 closures.

source_checks.finding: EUR-Lex direct page challenged, but indexed primary report specifies these three Turkish Cypriot suspensions at reporting-period start and reopening from June 4; Ledra Street was a separate Republic decision.
Direct UN page returned 403; indexed full statement establishes June 4 coordinated reopening under Orange testing conditions, not unrestricted crossing.
June 5 Famagusta News full article, credited to KYPE and quoting police, reports actual first-day crossings at Lefka, Limnitis and Deryneia. No new closure-onset date supplied.
Named southern checkpoint, distinct from northern Derinya office310m away; GreenLine is de facto divide, not interstate border.
Named Aplic/Aplıç border-gate government building supports route identity; exact Republic-side barrier not identified.
Named KatoPyrgos government checkpoint on route to Limnitis; northern refusal/checkpoint location not separately established.
